title: Electrical Safety Testing & Commissioning Pakistan 2026 — PAT Testing, Loop Impedance, RCD Test, Insulation Resistance (Megger) & Continuity Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete guide to electrical safety testing and commissioning in Pakistan 2026: PAT testing, loop impedance (Ze/Zs), RCD trip-time verification (IEC 61008/61009), insulation resistance (500V–5kV Megger), continuity testing, earth electrode measurement, EI Inspectorate certificate requirements, and PKR 2026 price table for 20 commissioning instruments.
